purpose: Re-measurement of Phase-8 loop-behavior metrics under live, non-transport-simulated acquisition, for direct comparison against the DEV/Validation Run 1/Validation Run 2 numbers already on record (all of which used transport-simulated follow-up acquisition).

sample.method: MedAgent(research_loop=True).run(query), full graph.invoke(), 100% live network + live Cerebras/NVIDIA calls - zero transport simulation, zero mocking.
sample.query_design_note: Queries were designed (not cherry-picked post-hoc) to plausibly exercise each source category and follow-up shape, following this project's own established pattern (docs/v2/PHASE8_FAILURE_ANALYSIS.md's DEV-D precedent: honest reporting of what actually happened, not iteration to force an outcome). 3 of 8 cases (LOCAL-05/06/07) resolved at round 0 with sufficient_evidence - a real, unforced outcome, not evidence of a broken loop.

mean_loops_per_query.cloud_val2: not directly recorded in phase8_validation_run2_metrics.json as this exact metric name - see that artifact for its own metric set
mean_loops_per_query.comparison: comparable order of magnitude to the cloud DEV figure (0.5, n=4); local sample skews slightly higher, consistent with the local query set deliberately including 2 explicit multi-iteration attempts (LOCAL-04, LOCAL-05) not present in DEV's 4-case set
mean_loops_per_query.classification: corroborated (same order of magnitude, no material contradiction) - n too small on both sides for a statistically powered comparison

unnecessary_follow_up_rate.local_live_n8: 0/6 actions unproductive = 0.0 (6/6 real follow-up actions taken were executed_productive)

productive_follow_up_rate.local_live_n8: 6/6 = 1.0 (every follow-up action taken acquired new, unique real Evidence)
productive_follow_up_rate.classification: consistent with cloud's loop_termination_correctness=4/4 in DEV - no local contradiction, though this specific rate name was not reported identically in cloud artifacts

fabricated_or_invalid_evidence_ids.classification: corroborated - unanimous across every cloud and local sample to date

real_world_result_quality_noise.local_live_observation: LOCAL-01 surfaced a real, previously-unobserved live-only interaction: grounded_generation_node's hard citation gate correctly rejected an LLM-generated citation to a bare 'pubmed:PMID' form when only a chunk-suffixed 'pubmed:PMID:chunk:N' form existed in Evidence[], under real mixed RAG-chunk + live-article PubMed Evidence. This is exactly the class of 'real-world result quality/noise' effect CTL-019 predicted transport-simulated metrics could not surface - the hard gate behaved safely (no fabricated answer), but this citation-ID-format interaction is a genuine new data point for Phase-9/11 quality work.
real_world_result_quality_noise.classification: new local-only finding, not present in any cloud sample - materially informative, not merely a re-measurement

summary.non_comparable_metrics: productive_follow_up_rate not reported under an identical name in cloud artifacts - directionally consistent, not a like-for-like re-measurement
new_findings_not_in_cloud_sample: the pubmed:PMID vs pubmed:PMID:chunk:N citation-ID-format interaction (LOCAL-01)
summary.insufficient_local_n_for: any claim beyond directional/order-of-magnitude comparison - n=8 local vs. n=4/8/6 cloud sub-samples are all too small for statistical significance
summary.closure_note: Per CTL-019's own text, this is 'not a pass/fail gate itself - a required re-measurement before any Phase-8 metric is cited as production-representative.' This re-measurement is now on record: no cloud metric is materially contradicted, and no cloud metric should yet be cited as production-representative on the strength of either sample (both are small-n). Full production-representative re-measurement at Phase-9/11 scale remains future work, as CTL-019 itself anticipates ('required closure phase: before Phase 11 cites any Phase-8 number as a product-facing claim').
